# One workflow for every dataset

Read the relevant example before running its commands. Use `synthetic`, `zeisel` or `your-study` consistently as the dataset name.

| Step | Your decision or output |
|---|---|
| Define | One answerable question and the unit of observation |
| Preview | Know which files and plots to expect |
| Meet | Understand rows, columns, metadata and provenance |
| Check | Validate raw counts, IDs and donor/sample mapping |
| Run | Save QC, transformed counts, PCA and parameters |
| Verify and Explain | Recalculate one cell; explain a plot with limitations |
| Write | Save a concise learner report in `reports/` |

A successful command means the calculation completed. It does not mean that the scientific interpretation is correct. Pause after each step and record what you checked.
